comment:
* Static library support version of the framework's {@link android.widget.PopupMenu}.
 * Used to write apps that run on platforms prior to Android 3.0.  When running
 * on Android 3.0 or above, this implementation is still used; it does not try
 * to switch to the framework's implementation. See the framework SDK
 * documentation for a class overview.

methods.name: public void setGravity(int gravity)
methods.comment:
* Sets the gravity used to align the popup window to its anchor view. *

* If the popup is showing, calling this method will take effect only * the next time the popup is shown. * * @param gravity the gravity used to align the popup window * @see #getGravity()

methods.name: public int getGravity()
methods.comment:
* @return the gravity used to align the popup window to its anchor view
     * @see #setGravity(int)

methods.name: public View.@NonNull OnTouchListener getDragToOpenListener()
methods.comment:
* Returns an {@link View.OnTouchListener} that can be added to the anchor view * to implement drag-to-open behavior. *

* When the listener is set on a view, touching that view and dragging * outside of its bounds will open the popup window. Lifting will select * the currently touched list item. *

* Example usage: * 

     * PopupMenu myPopup = new PopupMenu(context, myAnchor);
     * myAnchor.setOnTouchListener(myPopup.getDragToOpenListener());
     *
* * @return a touch listener that controls drag-to-open behavior

methods.name: public Menu getMenu()
methods.comment:
* Returns the {@link Menu} associated with this popup. Populate the
     * returned Menu with items before calling {@link #show()}.
     *
     * @return the {@link Menu} associated with this popup
     * @see #show()
     * @see #getMenuInflater()

methods.name: public MenuInflater getMenuInflater()
public void inflate(@MenuRes int menuRes)
methods.comment:
* Inflate a menu resource into this PopupMenu. This is equivalent to
     * calling {@code popupMenu.getMenuInflater().inflate(menuRes, popupMenu.getMenu())}.
     *
     * @param menuRes Menu resource to inflate

methods.name: public void show()
methods.comment:
* Show the menu popup anchored to the view specified during construction.
     *
     * @see #dismiss()

methods.name: public void setOnMenuItemClickListener(@Nullable OnMenuItemClickListener listener)
methods.comment:
* Sets a listener that will be notified when the user selects an item from
     * the menu.
     *
     * @param listener the listener to notify

methods.name: public void setOnDismissListener(@Nullable OnDismissListener listener)
methods.comment:
* Sets a listener that will be notified when this menu is dismissed.
     *
     * @param listener the listener to notify

methods.name: public void setForceShowIcon(boolean forceShowIcon)
methods.comment:
* Sets whether the popup menu's adapter is forced to show icons in the * menu item views. *

* Changes take effect on the next call to show(). * * @param forceShowIcon {@code true} to force icons to be shown, or * {@code false} for icons to be optionally shown

methods.name: ListView getMenuListView()
methods.comment:
* Returns the {@link ListView} representing the list of menu items in the currently showing
     * menu.
     *
     * @return The view representing the list of menu items.
